summary: Render release records as readable Markdown without gratuitous escapes.

details.problem: Generated release notes escaped every punctuation mark and padded ordinary code references, making otherwise complete issue-level records difficult to read.
details.changes: Escape only Markdown and HTML-sensitive metadata syntax, keep ordinary punctuation readable, and render simple owned references as normal inline code while retaining safe fencing for embedded backticks.
details.apply: Use the normal prepare-release workflow and review the generated RELEASE_NOTES.md against release.json before publication.
details.compatibility: No breaking change. Schema-v5 manifests and legacy release-note data remain readable; the selected release-notes@1 structure and published v2.5.0 body are not rewritten.
details.notes: This correction applies to subsequently generated release bodies. Published release artifacts remain immutable and must be corrected only through the owner's release policy.
